module_summary: Simple dual-port synchronous RAM: a register array written at write_addr when write_en, read into a registered read_data output when read_en (cleared otherwise).

anchors.name: RAM
anchors.why: Memory array storing words written via write port; source of read_data.

anchors.name: write_data
anchors.why: Write-port data stored into RAM at write_addr.

anchors.name: read_data
anchors.why: Registered read-port output loaded from RAM[read_addr] when read_en, else zero.

anchors.name: write_addr
anchors.why: Selects RAM word written by write_data.

anchors.name: read_addr
anchors.why: Selects RAM word loaded into read_data.

anchors.name: write_en
anchors.why: Write enable gating RAM array update.

anchors.name: read_en
anchors.why: Read enable loading read_data from RAM, else clearing it.

groups.name: ram_array
groups.description: Register-array storage with independent write and read ports.

groups.name: write_port
groups.description: Synchronous write of write_data to RAM[write_addr] under write_en.

groups.name: read_port
groups.description: Registered read of RAM[read_addr] into read_data under read_en.
